decisions.reason: Although this binder remains somewhat more adjacent than the machinery products, its flagship role, circular-economy fit, and the firm's growth and R&D capacity still make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core offer and strategically prominent, so in a growing innovative firm it remains a strong option to retain while market potential continues to clarify.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's modular recycling capabilities well, and absent clear failure signals the firm would likely keep this relatively adjacent option on the market rather than redeploy resources now.
